kpis_story.description_fr: Novembre 2024 : UniCredit lance OPA hostile sur Banco BPM (€10.1Md, échange actions). Refus du board BAMI, intervention government italien. Issue en jeu Q1-Q2 2025.
kpis_story.description_en: November 2024: UniCredit launches hostile takeover bid on Banco BPM (€10.1B, share exchange). BAMI board refusal, Italian government intervention. Outcome at stake Q1-Q2 2025.
